propositions: In the live-search path, _diff_comments early-returns [] when local_comments is empty before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached, causing drift-affected children with zero local comments to miss the parent-drift breadcrumb that the snapshot path emits.

The fix requires extracting the Jira-comment-set resolution and breadcrumb-precondition logic into separate helpers (_snapshot_comment_set, _live_comment_set, _breadcrumb_target) to reduce _diff_comments complexity below its McCabe ceiling while enabling conditional comment fetching in the live-search branch.

When no local comments exist but a breadcrumb may apply (drift condition + bound ancestor detected), the live-search path must fetch comments for the dedup set even with zero local comments; client-None and fetch-failure cases still return [] to preserve bug-4292 unknown-state safety.

The breadcrumb cluster (PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG, _breadcrumb_target, _build_parent_breadcrumb) is extracted into a new sibling module parent_breadcrumb.py and re-exported from outbound_comments to maintain backward compatibility with existing import sites.
The defect is a scope gap in S7 plan 2c66-205d-92e1-4419 where the breadcrumb append was added after the snapshot-carried guard without covering the live-search fallback path.
